purpose: Authorized workspace, preview tabs and encoding UI; Moye feature tests, not Telari differential acceptance

results.name: native authorized folder opens a file tree without arbitrary path capability
single-click preview reuses globally across pinned navigation and never exceeds 20 tabs
workspace search finds a document inside a still-collapsed directory
same-directory next and previous follow numeric Markdown order and skip TXT
unknown file token is rejected without replacing current document
expanded nested directory refreshes after an external add and removal
workspace header chooses through the document controller and hiding returns focus to the editor
slow native file reading locks real input until the replacement document is ready
GB18030 guessed encoding is visible and explicitly confirmable
UTF16 BOM opens correctly and explicit conversion persists UTF8 bytes
explicit Big5 selection survives a full application restart without exposing the filename in preferences
